name: Animal Simulator
desc:
Controls:
Q - Attack
Shift - Run/Walk
R - Sit
T - Rest

- Collect coins to level up fast and unlock rare animal skins
- Roleplay
- Fight
- Or do nothing at all
Anyways, thank u guys so much for playing

You gain  [(1000 * exp multiplier) + player_level] exp per hit

Play as Lion, Tiger, Hyena, Horse, Komodo Dragon, Deer, Gorilla, Bear, Rabbit, Rhino, Cat, Husky, Dinosaur, Penguin, Spider, Dragon, Kangaroo, Fox, Monkey, Elephant, Wolf, Axolotl, Crocodile or Snake!
